propositions: Tickets with live supersedes/duplicates links cannot be closed via rebar transition --class=superseded because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation that is impossible to earn for genuinely superseded work

The close_plan_review_gate_check function lacks visibility into the close_class disposition parameter and cannot exempt administrative closes even when live-link evidence exists, while the completion verification gate correctly honors the same evidence

Using --force to bypass the gate is the only workaround and records no signed attestation, degrading the audit trail for evidence-backed administrative dispositions and stripping completion signatures from ancestor epics

The plan-review gate should exempt link-backed administrative dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link returns true, distinguishing this from type exemptions and --force bypasses in the audit trail

The asymmetry was introduced when commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab extended administrative dispositions to task/story/epic tickets (making them subject to the plan-review gate) but only updated close_precheck.py and transition_close.py, leaving gates.py unmodified
